tenderSchedule.title: Providing Housekeeping Services
tenderSchedule.description: Department of Treasuries (DoT) intends to select an agency for providing Housekeeping Services to the Office of Commissioner of Treasuries at 5th & 6th Floor, KPCL Green Building, Palace Road, Bengaluru - 560001

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Commissionerate of Treasuries, KPCL Green Building, Palace Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condition as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submission of Covering letter as required in the given format
Furnishing of the Power of Attorney
The bidder should have been registered with ESI, PF, Labour departments/ authorities in the state of Karnataka
The bidder should have provided Housekeeping services to any commercial Private, Public, Govt. semi govt. institutions worth Rs.10 Lakhs every year in last 3 years
Submission of Last 3 years ESI/EPF paid Challans
The bidder should obtain Latest Income Tax clearance Certificate from I.T. Department or IT returns
Bidder should hold valid Good & Services Tax registration certificate and Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by income tax department.
The bidder should have an annual turnover of at least 55 Lakhs, each year in last 3 years. (i.e 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25)
